60-74.opener: Decent effort, but a few things to address.

40-59.opener: Your pressing form needs significant attention.

grip_ratio.note: grip_ratio=(grip_width - shoulder_width)/shoulder_width; ideal 20-120% wider than shoulders.

rom_top.note: 50% of ROM score. Max elbow extension at top of press. >= 157° = full extension (100), <= 110° = poor extension (0). 153° ~= 92.

rom_bottom.note: 50% of ROM score. Binary check: did elbow landmark (13/14) go below shoulder landmark (11/12) in image Y coords at bottom frames?

max_elbow_angle.note: 3D elbow angle at lockout, sustained >= 0.5 s

elbow_flare.note: angle between upper-arm (elbow→shoulder) and torso-down (hip→shoulder) during concentric phase. At bottom: ~90deg; at lockout: ~170deg. Ideal concentric mean: 90-150deg. Excluded from diagonal views due to foreshortening.

tiers.mild: Press just a little higher to reach full lockout.
tiers.moderate: Lift higher — you're stopping short of full extension.
tiers.severe: You're cutting the rep short — press to full overhead lockout.

tiers.mild: Lower the bar a touch more before pressing again.
tiers.moderate: Go lower — bring the bar to chin level before driving up.
tiers.severe: You're barely lowering the bar — descend to chin level before each press.

tiers.mild: Drive through a bit more at the top of each rep.
tiers.moderate: Push through — your lockout is incomplete at the finish.
tiers.severe: You're not locking out at all — press through to full elbow extension.

tiers.mild: Keep your elbows a touch more forward during the press.
tiers.moderate: Elbows are flaring out — tuck them in toward your sides.
tiers.severe: Your elbows are winging wide — keep them under the bar path.

tiers.mild: Try a slightly more controlled tempo on the way up.
tiers.moderate: The press is jerky — smooth out your ascent and descent.
tiers.severe: Your tempo is very uneven — drive smoothly from start to finish.

tiers.mild: Keep the bar path a touch straighter next rep.
tiers.moderate: The bar is wandering — control the path on the way up and down.
tiers.severe: Bar path is all over the place — stabilise your shoulders and guide the bar in a straight line.

tiers.mild: Check your grip width — try just outside shoulder width.
tiers.moderate: Grip is off — hands just outside shoulder width gives the strongest position.
tiers.severe: Your grip width needs correction — set hands just outside shoulder width.

tiers.mild: Stay mindful of your knees — keep them stable throughout.
tiers.moderate: Knees are buckling — brace your legs during the press.
tiers.severe: Knees are collapsing significantly — stabilise your lower body before pressing.
